name: smwmusic-super-hang-on-outride-a-crisis
title: Super Hang-On - Outride A Crisis
description:
This is Outride A Crisis, A.K.A Super Hang-On's most famous theme (even appeared in Sonic Riders in fact!). Useful for levels with sunset based aesthetics.

UPDATE: Brought the song size a couple of bytes, considerably optimized the text size, and completely overhauled the samples. Also added a bit more echo too, just for the heck of it :P

Released for the Super Nintenesis album.
